translations.translatedText: # Monday 7.10.2019 (radio)

Dual citizens are stuck in Turkey. Turkey plans to attack northern Syria. More people have died in the protests in Iraq. Finland's economy is weakening. The Kuopio school attack is being investigated.
## Dual citizens are stuck in Turkey

![Portraits of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk and Recep Tayyip Erdoğan on the wall of a building.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4096,h_2304,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-5158255bbe1e5990c01/1722511386)
Open image viewer
Photo: EPA-EFE/SRDJAN SUKI

According to Yle's information, Turkey has stopped some Finnish citizens from leaving the country. Exit bans have been given to some dual citizens, who have both Turkish and Finnish citizenship. Turkey says that one reason for the exit bans is suspicion of terrorism. Information collected from social media has been used as evidence. The Finnish Foreign Ministry says that it is trying to help dual citizens who are not allowed to leave Turkey.
## Turkey plans to attack northern Syria

![Turkish soldiers on their way to Idlib in Syria in October 2019.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2500,h_1406,x_0,y_27/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-5844445d5b59984e12c/1566267847)
Open image viewer
Turkish soldiers on their way to Idlib in Syria in October 2019. Photo: EPA-EFE/Yahya Nemah

Turkey plans to attack the Kurdish area in Syria. Turkey wants to push the Kurdish forces away from the area near the Turkey-Syria border. Turkey also wants to create a safe zone in the area. The United States has earlier announced that it will withdraw its troops from northern Syria. The United States has previously supported the Kurds when they fought against the Islamic State.
## More people have died in the protests in Iraq
![An injured protester is carried away](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3000,h_1688,x_0,y_244/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-5965905d9740e7bf5eb/1570193854)
Open image viewer
More than 40 people have died in the protests and hundreds have been injured. Photo: Ahmed Jalil / EPA

The Iraqi army admits that it used too much force against the protesters. Last night 13 people died when security forces attacked the protesters. For the first time, the army now admits that it has used too much force. The protesters say that soldiers shot straight at them. The protests began last week on Tuesday. Almost 100 people have died in them.
## Finland's economy is weakening
![Coins stacked in piles that get higher and higher.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3076,x_0,y_350/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-417980597edafe18f12/1501485919)
Open image viewer
Photo: Copyright � 2013 Roland Magnusson, all rights reserved

Finland's economy is expected to weaken. The ministry responsible for Finland's economy has made a new estimate of how Finland's economy will grow this year. According to the new estimate, the economy will grow by 1.5 percent. The previous forecast was 1.6 percent. Finland's economy is helped by the fact that Finns buy goods and services produced in Finland.
## The Kuopio school attack is being investigated

![Cordon tape with the text "dangerous area" outside the shopping centre where the vocational college in Kuopio is based.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1600,h_900,x_0,y_43/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-5953495d9395c17943d/1569953332)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle

Almost all of those injured in the Kuopio school attack have been discharged from hospital. Two people are still being treated at Kuopio University Hospital. One of them is the man suspected of carrying out the attack. The National Bureau of Investigation says that it is continuing to investigate the attack on the school. A young man stabbed people at the Savo Vocational College in Kuopio last Tuesday. 10 people were injured and 1 person died.
